description: The plot illustrates the trend of Pass@1 rate on Visual Navigation as the number of reasoning steps increases for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Reasoning Steps" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 5 to 40, with tick labels at 5, 10, 20, and 40. The y-axis is labeled "Pass@1 Rate (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The plot displays two lines: the dark blue line with circle markers represents GPT-4o, and the light blue line with cross markers represents Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The GPT-4o line starts at 6.5% at 5 reasoning steps, increases to 32.3% at 10 steps, then to 77.4% at 20 steps, and finally reaches 83.9% at 40 steps. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet line begins at 19.4% at 5 steps, rises to 38.7% at 10 steps, then to 87.1% at 20 steps, and ends at 89.2% at 40 steps. Both lines exhibit a steady increase across the x-axis, with a more rapid rise between 10 and 20 steps.
